title: Is the mean the crowd’s accuracy?
hook: Two toy groups contribute judgments with fixed individual hit rates; inspect their mix.

knows: basic arithmetic and how to compare two stated rules
doesNotKnow: how to distinguish a mean individual hit rate from collective decision accuracy

misconception: The mean accuracy of individuals directly establishes the accuracy of a crowd’s combined decision.
objective: Distinguish a mean individual hit rate from collective decision accuracy.
